text:
maria: FYI hitting a weird ESM/CJS/bundler quirk in the sample app when building for production. Dev server + SSR fine, but the prod bundle made with vite -> rollup chain causes auth to break in the browser. Minimal repro below.

maria: Repro (short):
1) git clone https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-edge-bundler-quirk
2) yarn && yarn build (vite prod, custom rollup plugins)
3) serve -s dist and open /chat
4) click "New convo" which calls client -> /api/generate (edge function)

maria: Symptom: UI spins indefinitely. Network tab shows repeated POST /v1/generate attempts. First request 401, SDK does refresh -> sets token -> immediate retry sends Authorization: Bearer undefined. Happens only in prod chunked build (cross-chunk live binding?).

maria: console snippet:```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 401
SDK auth: refresh ok -> setAuth(token.x)
SDK auth: retrying -> Authorization: Bearer undefined
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 401
```

alex: Can you paste the import lines from both server (edge) and client? I suspect namespace import -> bundler wrapper mismatch.

maria: server (edge): ```js
import { createHandler } from '@redwood/sdk';
export default createHandler({/*...*/});
```
client: ```js
import * as Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
await Redwood.callGenerate(...);
```

sam: That pattern can fail when rollup converts modules into interop wrappers. `import * as` yields a namespace object; if the SDK relies on a mutable module-level object (e.g., exports.token = ...) the live setter might not survive chunk boundaries.

julie: Quick try: does `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` change anything?

maria: Swapped to default import in client and rebuilt, staging works — single successful request. So default import avoids the broken wrapper in our bundle.

alex: Share vite.config/rollupOptions? plugin order (svg plugin, commonjs, node-resolve, terser) can affect how wrappers are emitted. Also TS flags like esModuleInterop influence dev vs prod behavior.

maria: vite.config excerpt: ```js
export default defineConfig({ build: { rollupOptions: { plugins: [svgPlugin(), commonjs()] } } });
```

sam: Mitigations we discussed:
- client: prefer explicit default import (works but is brittle if consumers have strict TS flags)
- build: set output.inlineDynamicImports = true or avoid cross-chunk live bindings so mutated module state is contiguous
- SDK: export a stable named setter function (e.g., export function setAuthToken(t) {}) instead of mutating exported object properties

julie: There's also a typings problem: consumers without esModuleInterop see no `default` on the imported module and TS errors. We should ship d.ts that exposes both default and named exports so both patterns type-check.

maria: I've opened an internal issue with a minimal repro branch and test harness that runs a headless build + puppeteer smoke to assert the Authorization header is correct after refresh. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-edge-bundler-quirk (branch: prod-chunk-repro).

ci-bot: build trace snippet:```
[vite] building for production...
rollup: transforming node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js -> dist/chunk-pq9a.js
created dist/chunk-pq9a.js (47kb)
```

alex: Action items:
- SDK: add a named export `setAuthToken` and make token setter pure. (assign @alex)
- Eng-DevEx: add CI smoke that builds sampleapp with our plugin stack and runs a headless check. (assign @sam)
- Docs: add onboarding note about import styles for edge/bundled single-file builds and the TS interop caveat. (assign @julie)

maria: temp workaround applied to our sampleapp branch (replace `import * as` with default import). Will PR once tests pass. Thanks! :thumbsup:
